routes.label: Similar triangles in a cone section

before.rationale: The sphere centers form an equilateral triangle at height r, whose circumradius gives their distance from the cone axis. A section through the axis and a sphere center converts side tangency into a perpendicular-radius condition.

Angle bisector and similarity in the axial section

after.rationale: The sphere centers form an equilateral triangle at height r, whose circumradius gives their distance from the cone axis. In an axial section, side tangency can be treated by the stored angle-bisector and similarity argument, direct perpendicular-triangle similarity, or center-to-line distance.
